d: A humanoid creature with a massive, muscular build, featuring a deep crimson mane of thick, wavy hair that flows down the back and platinum white hair framing the face. The eyes are small and narrow with golden-yellow irises, set into a face with a mature, weathered expression and a red marking over the right brow. The attire consists of a dark grey and brown tunic with gold metallic accents, a wide leather belt with a red gemstone, and dark trousers tucked into heavy boots. Visible non-human traits include two large, sweeping ivory horns with red tips and thick, greyish-brown skin. BODY COLOR: Greyish-brown LEGS: Plantigrade with thick, rounded toes.
